Through four intensive internships at premier institutions including the National Center of Artificial Intelligence (NCAI) and FlyRank AI, I have engineered end-to-end multimodal AI pipelines, deployed custom YOLO object detection models, and built executive-grade dashboards that transform raw data into high-impact operational insights.

Whether optimizing deep neural network architectures (ResNet, U-Net, Vision Transformers) or crafting predictive analytics in Python and SQL, I pride myself on writing clean, reproducible code and communicating analytical findings clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.

projects.title: RiskRadar – AI-Powered Workplace Hazard Detection & Safety Management System
projects.description:
RiskRadar is an AI-powered mobile application developed using Flutter, Supabase, Firebase, and Google Gemini AI to improve workplace safety through intelligent hazard detection and real-time incident reporting.

The system enables workers to report workplace hazards using images, descriptions, and voice notes, while AI analyzes uploaded images to identify potential safety risks. Safety officers can review incidents, assign corrective tasks to contractors, and track hazard resolution.

Key Features: AI-based hazard image analysis, real-time hazard reporting, role-based access (Worker, Safety Officer, Contractor), task assignment, incident tracking, offline synchronization, SOS functionality, and push notifications.
